source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 35 visible fx-880BTG PLUS observations; all accepted whole-LCD/status comparisons. No masked or deferred samples. JSON saved directly in the project.
Initial unit/small result setting changes freeze the old displayed result; their frame IDs were renamed to distinguish these from fresh calculations after setting changes.

Fresh 1+i under Fix 1 displays 1.0+1.0i; under Sci 3 it displays 1.00e0+1.00e0i; Norm 2 displays 1+i. PLUS elides the imaginary coefficient only when its formatted text is exactly 1. Legacy 580 behavior is retained.
Fresh tiny components under Fix remain 0.0+0.0i, 0.0+1.0i, or 0.0i as appropriate; decimal comma is observed.

Wide one-line complex results start at the left LCD edge and scroll in eight-pixel steps with bounded endpoints and continuation arrows. EXE resets the offset; a frozen long result remains scrollable after changing Fix.
LineI rectangular components stay on two rows after FORMAT, including an exact 1/3 component rendered inline on its own row. MathI decimal FORMAT also uses separate component rows.

New 6x9 script glyphs come from visible native pixels: binary minus x110,y0 of complex-format-small-sci3, plus/multiply x17,y0, and parentheses x11/x35,y0 of the math-script frames. Binary minus is five pixels wide; unary minus retains its existing three-pixel stroke.
Independent Calculate probes 2^(2+3), 2^(2*3), 2^((2+3)), 2^(-2) using binary/unary minus validate the script glyphs; results are 32,64,32,1/4,1/4.
